query: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM agent_conversation_sessions session JOIN comms_channel_agents agent ON agent.channel_id = session.channel_id AND agent.bot_id = session.bot_id WHERE session.session_id = $1 AND agent.kind = 'direct') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM agent_session s WHERE s.id = $1 AND s.message_visibility->>'type' = 'private') AS "exists!"
